about: Code-facing design names (data-u-id, data-u-bind, data-u-arg, data-u-action, data-u-repeat, data-u-state, data-u-screen) and the C# member part the Unity view generator makes of each (Naming.Pascal), null where it rejects the name. design-export lint (U-MRK-005 memberPart) and the generator both test against this list.
